english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for letting someone escape harm or punishment.
Use 放過 when the speaker knowingly lets a person or fault go without blame or punishment.
Use this when forgiving means letting someone off or choosing not to pursue the matter.
Use this colloquial choice when forgiving someone means letting the person off or overlooking the offence.

examples.english: Please spare me this time; I definitely won't dare do it again next time.
examples.traditional: 今次你放過我，下次我一定唔敢喇。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 nei5 fong3 gwo3 ngo5 haa6 ci3 ngo5 jat1 ding6 m4 gam2 laa3

examples.english: You made this mistake for the first time, so I’ll overlook it and won’t pursue it.
examples.traditional: 今次你第一次犯，我就放過你，唔追究喇。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 nei5 dai6 jat1 ci3 faan6 ngo5 zau6 fong3 gwo3 nei5 m4 zeoi1 gau3 laa3

examples.english: I’ll pardon you this time, but don’t do it again.
examples.traditional: 今次我放過你，下次唔好再犯。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 fong3 gwo3 nei5 haa6 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 faan6
gam1 ci3 nei5 dei6 fong3 gwo3 ngo5 laa1
